entries.en: If you allow yourself to get too close to its hypnotic dance, you'll get bitten.
entries.ro: Dacă te apropii prea mult de dansul său hipnotic, vei fi mușcat.

entries.en: While it may not growl, it thuds, and it hurts.
entries.ro: Deși nu mârâie, lovește surd și doare.

entries.en: Once you see its flash, it's too late.
entries.ro: Odată ce îi vezi strălucirea, e prea târziu.

entries.en: Skulk and tail weaker prey with these weapons inspired by one of Japan's most mystic night prowlers.
